high.title: VN-Index Can Exceed 2,300 Points?
high.summary: Dragon Securities (VDSC) reports that the market has not fully repriced the high profit base from Q1 2026 earnings season. VN-Index movements have been mainly driven by individual stocks with supporting stories, while most stocks have deeply reflected risks of declining growth from prolonged energy shocks and high interest rates. VDSC suggests the market lacks confidence in the sustainability of the profit cycle, with risk premiums remaining high despite strong Q1 results. Market expectations over the next 3 months will heavily depend on Middle East developments. The securities firm believes geopolitical tensions may be approaching a cooling point in the medium term, though not completely resolved. This analysis is crucial for VND and equity positioning as it suggests significant upside potential if investor confidence returns and valuations expand to match the strong profit foundation.

high.title: Identifying the "Heroes" That Made the 1,900-Point Peak History for VN-Index
high.summary: Vietnam's stock market hit a new all-time high as VN-Index surged past the crucial 1,900-point threshold on May 7, reaching an intraday peak of 1,924.95 points before closing at 1,909.01 (+0.94%). This surpassed the previous record of 1,902 points set on January 13, 2026. Trading volume on HOSE exceeded VND 30 trillion, up 15% from the previous session. Vingroup stocks (VIC, VHM) were the main drivers, with VHM hitting the daily limit contributing 9.15 points and VIC gaining over 2% contributing 7.36 points. The breakthrough above 1,900 points represents a significant psychological and technical milestone for Vietnamese equities, potentially attracting more foreign inflows and supporting VND stability through improved investor sentiment.

high.title: Stock Market Hits New Peak, Securities Firm Names 5 Stock Groups with Money-Attracting Opportunities This Month
high.summary: SHS Securities notes VN-Index's April 2026 performance closely followed their base scenario from their 2026 strategy report. The market recovered strongly and returned to the 1,900-point zone, led by large-cap and sector-leading stocks. For May, focus will be on April macroeconomic data including inflation, import-export, and PMI figures, expected to better reflect the impact of Middle East conflicts on businesses and the economy. SHS notes global geopolitical tensions continue and are shifting to a new state, with credit growth showing signs of slowing while energy crisis, inflation, and cost pressures increasingly affect businesses. However, Vietnam's economy maintains growth momentum with supportive policies. This outlook is critical for understanding near-term VND and equity market dynamics.

medium.title: Dynamic Capital Increase Phase: Securities Industry About to Welcome First Company with Charter Capital Exceeding VND 30,000 Billion
medium.summary: S&I Ratings evaluates 2026 as a dynamic period for capital increases in the securities industry due to three pressures: Decree 245/2025 opening foreign ownership to 100% for securities companies, top firms approaching 200% margin lending limits, and Circular 102/2025 raising risk coefficients 10-30%. SSI plans to increase capital by approximately VND 9,262 billion in 2026, potentially becoming the first securities firm to exceed VND 30,000 billion in charter capital.

medium.title: Agribank Receives Moody's Ratings Outlook Adjustment from "Stable" to "Positive"
medium.summary: Moody's Ratings upgraded Agribank's outlook from "Stable" to "Positive" following Vietnam's sovereign rating outlook upgrade on May 4, 2026. The agency praised Vietnam's improving economic competitiveness through digital transformation, infrastructure investment, and capital market development. Agribank's stable funding base and asset quality were highlighted as key credit strengths.

medium.title: Two Large Foreign-Sold Stocks Lost Over Trillion VND During Index's Historic Peak Week
medium.summary: During the week VN-Index hit historic highs (May 4-8), foreign investors net sold VND 4,158 billion across the market despite the positive momentum. On HOSE alone, foreign net selling reached VND 4,351 billion. MSN led foreign buying with VND 609 billion, followed by POW (VND 593 billion). This foreign selling pressure during a market rally suggests potential headwinds for sustained VND strength.

medium.title: FPT Shares Hit Bottom, Market Cap Evaporates Over VND 40,000 Billion Since Year-Start
medium.summary: FPT shares fell to VND 71,900, the lowest level in 27 months since February 2024, down 25% year-to-date with market cap losing over VND 40,700 billion. Foreign investors have net sold nearly VND 13,900 billion of FPT shares since the beginning of 2026, representing a significant shift from previous strong foreign demand for this tech leader.

medium.title: One Bank to Pay Cash Dividends Worth Nearly VND 5,000 Billion
medium.summary: Techcombank (TCB) announced 7% cash dividend payment (VND 700/share) totaling over VND 4,960 billion. The record date is May 20, 2026, with payment scheduled for June 10, 2026. This marks the third consecutive year of cash dividend payments, with additional 60% stock dividend planned for 2026.
